description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.002 USDC per call via x402] Set and order operations on lists of up to 50000 items, done exactly (language models drop or duplicate items in long lists). ops: dedupe (with the duplicates and their counts), sort (natural order: item2 before item10), union, intersection, difference (in a, not in b), symmetric_difference, frequency (each value and how often), compare (only in a, only in b, in both). Options: ignoreCase, trim (default true), sort the result. Order is first appearance unless you sort. Deterministic.

b.description: the second list (union, intersection, difference, symmetric_difference, compare)

ignoreCase.description: treat "Acme" and "ACME" as the same (the first spelling seen is kept); default false

natural.description: natural order when sorting (item2 < item10); default true

sort.description: order of the result; default none (first appearance), asc for op sort

trim.description: remove leading/trailing spaces and empty items first; default true

name: list_ops
title: Exact list operations: dedupe, sort, union, intersection, difference, compare
